errors.text_span: “时间常识” 切片呈浅蓝色
errors.evidence: The slice for “时间常识” (Temporal common sense) is dark blue, not light blue (浅蓝色). The light blue slice corresponds to “空间常识” (Spatial common sense).
The percentage for “时间常识” (Temporal common sense) is 13.88% as shown in the chart, not 13.38%.
The slice for “空间常识” (Spatial common sense) is light blue, not yellow (黄色). The yellow slice corresponds to “物理常识” (Physical common sense).
The slice for “物理常识” (Physical common sense) is yellow, not orange (橙色).
The phrase '切片以一位角排列' (slices are arranged in a corner/angle) is nonsensical in the context of describing a pie chart and its structure.
